annotations.title: Token safety check (honeypot, tax, verified list)

description: Check a token on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) before trading it: verified-list status (curated list, KyberSwap verified list), KyberSwap honeypot / fee-on-transfer flags, EIP-1967 upgradeable proxy, a simulated transfer that measures the real transfer tax, and for unknown tokens a simulated SELL back to USDC that catches blocked-sell honeypots. Returns verdict ok / caution / blocked with each check. Heuristics only; read-only, nothing is signed.

amount.description: Test size in HUMAN units for the simulations. Default 1 token.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

deep.description: Run the sell simulation for unverified tokens (default true; 2 aggregator calls).

token.description: Token to check: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.
